title: Millie Bobby Brown and Jake Bongiovi Go Monochromatic for Parents’ Night Out

 By Hannah Jackson October 21, 2026 BlayzenPhotos / BACKGRID USA Save Story Save this story Save Story Save this story A parents’ night out is probably all too rare for Millie Bobby Brown and Jake Bongiovi : the couple reportedly adopted their second child earlier this year. But last night, the pair found a sitter (Grandpa Jon Bon Jovi, perhaps?) and dashed out to dinner at the ever-bustling Corner Store in New York City.
 Both Brown and Bongiovi opted for full monochromatic looks for their date night. The actor, for her part, was thinking pink in a three-piece faux suede set from Modalità Vacanza: a cropped blush mock neck top and matching low-slung pencil skirt allowed for maximum ab-baring, while a button-up jacket shielded her from the crisp fall air. Brown’s accessories would make a noughties socialite proud: a pair of fuchsia pointy-toe slingbacks with a black cap toe continued the pink throughline, while her oversized rounded sunglasses and Gucci Boston bag delivered plenty of attitude.
 BlayzenPhotos / BACKGRID USA Bongiovi got the monochrome memo, but chose a far more subdued look than his wife, wearing a navy polo shirt and trousers with well-worn ecru sneakers.
 While these two are clearly on the same page with their palettes, their fashion choices reflect their longstanding personal styles. Be it on the red carpet for her Enola Holmes premiere or a night on the town , Jake Bongiovi is always happy to let Millie Bobby Brown shine.
